    factors.add((factor = int.parse(parts[0]), word = parts[1]))
od

for n in 1::max_n do
    let label = factors
        |> filter(f => n % f.factor == 0)
        |> map(f => f.word)
        |> join("")

    write_line(if label.length == 0 then "{n}" else label fi)
